annotations.title: Find products at retailers that take offers or price match

description: Searches the products the Registry has pulled from its retailers' own catalogues (Shopify stores, up to 500 products each) and returns each hit with its price, its page at the store, when it was last seen, and the store's verified facts: whether it accepts offers (true only when the store is in the engine's live list) and whether it price matches (yes or no only after a person verified the policy; unknown otherwise). Filter by country, a ceiling on price, only stores that take offers, or only stores with a verified price-match policy. Prices and availability are as of last_seen_at; confirm on the product page before quoting. Not every retailer's products are listed, so an empty result is not a no.

accepts_offers.description: true: only stores where a shopper can make an offer. Optional.

country.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code, e.g. AU. Optional.

limit.description: How many products to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

price_match.description: true: only stores with a verified price-match policy. Optional.

price_max.description: Only products whose lowest price is at or under this, in the store's currency. Optional.

query.description: What the shopper wants, in a few words, e.g. 'linen shirt', 'Dyson V15', 'gold hoop earrings'

name: find_products
title: Find products at retailers that take offers or price match
